result.instructions: Tools for Fiix, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many open work orders do we have for the packaging line?"; "Show the purchase orders from our top three suppliers this month."; "Which assets have no maintenance schedule yet?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Fiix data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fiix_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fiix_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fiix_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. fiix_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fiix_find_objects
tools.title: Find objects
tools.description: Find objects of one Fiix class (Account, Asset, PurchaseOrder, WorkOrder), optionally filtered by a Fiix QL expression with ? placeholders. Returns the objects with the fields you name, plus the total match count. Uses one Fiix API call per request (1,000 calls per day per user license).

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return, e.g. 'id, strDescription'. Use the Fiix API reference for names.

ql.description: Optional Fiix QL filter with ? placeholders, e.g. 'intSupplierID > ? and intSupplierID < ?'.

parameters.description: Values for the ? placeholders in ql, in order.

orderBy.description: Field to sort the results by.

tools.name: fiix_get_object
tools.title: Get object by id
tools.description: Read one Fiix object of a class by its numeric id, with the fields you name.

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return, e.g. 'id, strDescription'. Use the Fiix API reference for names.

tools.name: fiix_count_objects
tools.title: Count objects
tools.description: Count the Fiix objects of one class that match an optional Fiix QL filter. Returns only the total. Uses one Fiix API call per request (1,000 calls per day per user license).

ql.description: Optional Fiix QL filter with ? placeholders, e.g. 'intSupplierID > ? and intSupplierID < ?'.

parameters.description: Values for the ? placeholders in ql, in order.
